nodes.label: Window Global State Pattern
nodes.rationale: All UI components (primitives, mobile, web, iOS frame, browser chrome, data) register themselves on window via Object.assign(window, {...}). This pattern enables cross-file access in a no-bundler (plain script-tag) prototype environment where traditional ES module imports are unavailable.

nodes.label: Season as Required Tag
nodes.rationale: Season is a mandatory tag on every item (enforced in UX as 'required'). Items without a season are incomplete. Seasons are: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter, F/W, S/S.
